Quickstarts.title: Quickstarts | Intigris
Quickstarts.description: Intigris Quickstarts: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Field Service live in four weeks, and your first Agentforce agent in two. Fixed scope, built in your own Salesforce org.

SalesCloud.title: Sales Cloud | Intigris
SalesCloud.description: Salesforce Sales Cloud implemented by Intigris: all your customers and deals in one place, connected to Exact, AFAS, NetSuite and more. Start with a Quickstart from €7,000 or a full implementation.

FieldService-v3.title: Field Service | Intigris
FieldService-v3.description: Salesforce Field Service implemented by Intigris: planning, engineers and work orders in one system. Fewer kilometres, fewer second visits, invoices the same day. Quickstart from €13,000.

ServiceCloud.title: Service Cloud | Intigris
ServiceCloud.description: Salesforce Service Cloud implemented by Intigris: one queue for every channel and the whole customer in view. Live in four weeks with our Quickstart.

Agentforce.title: Agentforce Kickstart | Intigris
Agentforce.description: You already pay for Agentforce. We switch it on. The Agentforce Kickstart by Intigris: in two weeks your first working AI agent on your own Salesforce data, for a fixed €3,950, fully credited when you continue.

<style>
    @media (max-width: 560px) { .app-two { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; } }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
    @keyframes popIn { from { transform: translateY(12px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
    .vac-row { transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 180ms var(--ease-out); }
    .vac-row:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px -18px rgba(64,35,1,0.3); }
    .post-body { margin-top: 28px; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--intigris-dark-brown); font-weight: 400; }
    .post-body h2 { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 32px 0 12px; }
    .post-body p { margin: 0 0 16px; }
    .post-body ul { margin: 0 0 16px 22px; }
    .post-body li { margin: 6px 0; }

Blog.title: Blog | Intigris
Blog.body:
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<style>
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .blog-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 620px) {
      .blog-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
    }
    .post-body { margin-top: 28px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--intigris-dark-brown); font-weight: 400; }
    .post-body h2 { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 36px 0 12px; }
    .post-body h3 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; margin: 28px 0 10px; }
    .post-body h4 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 22px 0 8px; }
    .post-body p { margin: 0 0 18px; }
    .post-body ul, .post-body ol { margin: 0 0 18px 24px; }
    .post-body li { margin: 6px 0; }
    .post-body a { color: var(--intigris-coral); text-decoration: underline; }
    .post-body strong { font-weight: 600; }
    .post-body hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin: 32px 0; }
  </style>
